language.title: Language
language.pickerIntro: Interface language. What you are learning — Hangul letters, words and example sentences — stays in Korean.
language.coverageNote: Every language here translates the whole interface and the alphabet course. Where a row says so, word meanings and example sentences are still shown in English.
language.meaningsBody: Meanings and example translations are shown in {{language}}. You can read them in another language instead.

font.title: Korean typeface
font.description: Changes the Korean you read in the app. The letter you trace is always drawn the same way.

dailyTarget.title: Letters a day
dailyTarget.description: How many Hangul letters to finish each day.

wordGoal.title: Words a day
wordGoal.description: How many words to finish each day. You can change this any time.

guides.title: Writing guides
guides.description: The helper lines inside the box.

reset.title: Reset all learning progress?
reset.description: Your completed lessons, review history and learning activity will be cleared. This cannot be undone.
reset.body: Start again from the very first letter.

backup.body: Save your learning progress to a file and restore it on another phone.
backup.saveFailed: The copy could not be saved.
backup.restoreBody: Everything on this device will be replaced by the copy you choose. This cannot be undone.

problem.not_json: That file is not a copy of your learning.
problem.not_a_backup: That file is not a copy of your learning.
problem.from_a_newer_app: That copy was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app, then try again.
problem.empty: That copy has nothing in it.

voice.title: Pronunciation voice
voice.description: Who reads the letters, syllables and words aloud.
voice.provider: Two clear Korean voices, spoken a little slower than native pace so every sound lands.

activity.title: Learning activity
activity.body: Your streak, your calendar and what you have learned

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Light, dark, or whatever your phone is doing.

legal.title: Legal & Licences
legal.body: Licences for the content and typefaces in the app
legal.intro: Some of what is in the app is used under licences that ask to be credited. Those credits are here.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lede: Nothing you do here leaves this device.

device.title: Your learning stays here
points: What you have learned, and how well you remember it, is saved on this device. It is never uploaded.
There is no account — nothing to sign up for, and no profile of you anywhere.
If you save a copy of your learning, that file is yours — the app never sends it anywhere.

tracking.title: No ads, no tracking
points: The app does not watch how you use it and does not report anything back.
Handwriting is graded on screen as you draw it, then discarded.

permissions.title: Permissions
points: The app asks for no permissions at all.
Never the camera, microphone, photos, contacts or location.

erase.title: Erasing it
points: You can clear everything you have learned at the bottom of {{screen}}.
Deleting the app deletes it with it.

storage.notSaving: Your progress is not being saved on this device, so what you learn may be gone the next time you open the app. Allowing this site to keep data in your browser settings usually fixes it.
storage.recovered_one: {{count, number}} damaged record was skipped when loading. The rest of your progress is intact.
storage.recovered_other: {{count, number}} damaged records were skipped when loading. The rest of your progress is intact.
